variables.description:
Req for: the page behind everything
Use: elevation moves toward the page pole in both modes; a shadow marks the step in light

Req for: a recessed surface: an inset well, a table header
Use: elevation moves toward the page pole in both modes; a shadow marks the step in light

Req for: the resting surface of a panel or a section
Use: elevation moves toward the page pole in both modes; a shadow marks the step in light

Req for: the raised surface: a card, a menu, a dialog, an input
Use: elevation moves toward the page pole in both modes; a shadow marks the step in light

Req for: an inverted banner, card or toast
Use: the ground the on-inverse text and links are solved against; not interactive

Req for: the scrim behind a modal
Use: black
Compose by hand with opacity/scrim

Req for: running text
Use: body copy, labels, table cells, and the icons beside them

Req for: text that grabs the eye
Use: the lightest AA text: in the neutral, placeholders and timestamps; in a family, the color itself, so not for body text; never for disabled

Req for: icons and shapes only
Use: clears the non-text bar, not the text bar, so it is kept out of the text picker: never text, never disabled

Req for: secondary text
Use: captions, helper text, metadata

Req for: the strongest emphasis
Use: display text, a key figure; not for running text

Req for: a link in running text, at rest
Use: links no component owns; the Link component binds the same rows

Req for: a link in running text, under the pointer
Use: links no component owns; the Link component binds the same rows

Req for: a link in running text, while pressed
Use: links no component owns; the Link component binds the same rows

Req for: running text on an inverted ground
Use: on color/surface/inverse and on an accent fill; the pencil clears every paper

Req for: the quietest text on an inverted ground
Use: on color/surface/inverse only; the pens clear every chalk

Req for: secondary text on an inverted ground
Use: on color/surface/inverse only; the pens clear every chalk

Req for: the strongest text on an inverted ground
Use: on color/surface/inverse and on an accent fill

Req for: a link on an inverted ground, at rest
Use: re-solved for the inverted ground

Req for: a link on an inverted ground, under the pointer
Use: re-solved for the inverted ground

Req for: a link on an inverted ground, while pressed
Use: re-solved for the inverted ground

Req for: inputs, cards and dividers that must be seen
Use: the border that clears the non-text contrast bar

Req for: a border that grabs the eye
Use: an input in error, a highlighted card; not a regular border

Req for: the faintest border
Use: the card edge, rows in a table, items in a list

Req for: a decorative border
Use: strong dividers, and the border of the regular and muted grounds

Req for: an emphasized outline
Use: a selected card, a current step; kept in case, rarely the right border

Req for: the focus ring
Use: drawn the same on every control, outside its edge

Req for: borders on an inverted ground
Use: on color/surface/inverse only

Req for: the default ground with color
Use: an alert, a callout, a soft badge, with the regular or muted border; every fg word but hint reads on it

Req for: the fill that grabs the eye
Use: a solid badge, chip or progress fill; its text is fg/on-inverse/strong or regular, nothing else

Req for: the lightest ground
Use: a wash that barely leaves the surface; every fg word but hint reads on it
Reserved for components; hidden from publishing

Req for: a restrained ground
Use: a deeper tint than regular; every fg word but hint reads on it
Reserved for components; hidden from publishing

Req for: a heavy ground
Use: the strongest combo; fg/strong, regular and muted read on it, accent does not
Reserved for components; hidden from publishing

Req for: the ghost ground of a neutral control, at rest
Use: transparent: ghost and outline buttons, icon buttons, rows and menu items show the surface

Req for: the ghost ground of a neutral control, under the pointer
Use: the highlighter at an opacity, over the surface
Compose by hand with opacity/ghost/hover

Req for: the ghost ground of a neutral control, while pressed
Use: the highlighter at an opacity, over the surface

Req for: the soft ground of a neutral control, at rest

Compose by hand with opacity/soft/enabled

Req for: the soft ground of a neutral control, under the pointer

Req for: the soft ground of a neutral control, while pressed

Compose by hand with opacity/soft/pressed

Req for: the soft ground of a neutral control, when selected

Compose by hand with opacity/soft/selected
